seo.meta_description: LucasAI is an AI documentation assistant for behavioral health clinicians. Automates therapy notes with mental health-aware templates. HIPAA compliant.

faqs.a: AI documentation assistant designed for behavioral health providers. Transcribes therapy sessions and generates structured clinical notes. Built with mental health workflows in mind.

faqs.q: Is LucasAI designed for mental health?
faqs.a: Yes. LucasAI focuses on behavioral health documentation. It understands therapy terminology and generates notes appropriate for mental health settings.
AI listens to your session, transcribes the conversation, and drafts a note using your preferred template. You review and finalize before saving.
Yes. HIPAA compliant with BAA available for healthcare providers.

faqs.q: Can I customize note templates in LucasAI?
faqs.a: Yes. LucasAI supports template customization to match your documentation style and requirements.

faqs.q: How does LucasAI compare to other mental health scribes?
faqs.a: LucasAI is one of several behavioral health-specific AI scribes. Compare it with Upheal, Mentalyc, and Blueprint based on your specific EHR needs and documentation preferences.
